classification.difficultyReason: Use equal rectangle perimeters to find an unknown length through exact mixed-number calculations.

content.prompt: Rectangles A and B have the same perimeter. Find the missing length.

spec.description: Upright rectangle A appears left of taller, narrower rectangle B. Both have internal letter labels, horizontal dimension arrows below and vertical dimension arrows on their right.
spec.mathematics: A has width 2 3/4 cm and height 4 1/6 cm. B has height 6 2/3 cm and unknown width. Their perimeters are equal. Drawn proportions reproduce the source arrangement rather than a scale construction.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given measurements and the source question mark are visible.

answer.worked:
Let the missing length be $x$ cm. The perimeters are equal.
$$\begin{align*}
P_A&=2\left(2\frac{3}{4}+4\frac{1}{6}\right)\text{ cm}\\
P_A&=13\frac{5}{6}\text{ cm}\\
P_B&=\left(2x+2\left(6\frac{2}{3}\right)\right)\text{ cm}\\
P_B&=\left(2x+13\frac{1}{3}\right)\text{ cm}\\
2x&=13\frac{5}{6}-13\frac{1}{3}=\frac{1}{2}\\
x&=\frac{1}{4}
\end{align*}$$
The missing length is $\frac{1}{4}\text{ cm}$.
